32mm to 28mm: Heroic Down to True Tabletop Scale

The reverse of the most-asked question: shrinking a heroic 32mm figure to true 28mm scale, as when you bring a modern sculpt down to sit with classic true-scale (28mm) or 28mm fantasy RPG comrades.

Back to all conversions28mm to 32mm

The math

(28.0mm / 32.0mm) × 100 = 87.5%

Based on 175cm human baseline, eye-level measurement (160cm).

Scale baselines

  • Source eye level32.0mm Eye
  • Target eye level28.0mm Eye
  • Scale factor87.5%

Why shrink at all

Players occasionally want a heroic model to join a 28mm-led force. At 87.5% the figure loses its heroic presence and reads as a 28mm true-scale model — the proportions slim down with the size, which is exactly what you want when balancing an army.

Watch the slimming

Shrinking 32mm heroic to 28mm (87.5%) makes heads and weapons proportionally smaller, matching the target scale's realism. I confirm the eye line lands at 28mm after scaling rather than trusting the number alone.

How I got this number

By kitsorix, 3D printing hobbyist

This percentage comes from a 175cm human baseline with eye-level at 160cm. I print the result on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini and measure with digital calipers before I post it.

I test every percentage on FDM before publishing. PLA and PETG cool with minimal dimensional change — typically under 0.5%. If a number fails on my machine, I adjust it.

Quick Answers

What is 32mm to 28mm percentage?

87.5% — 28 ÷ 32 = 0.875. It shrinks a heroic figure to true 28mm scale with matching slimmer proportions.
